/-- A family of sets $F$ is of finite character iff for every set $X$, $X ∈ F$ iff every finite
subset of $X$ is in $F$ -/

results.name: finsum
results.source_text:
/-- Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise. -/
noncomputable irreducible_def finsum (lemma := finsum_def') [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) : M :=
  if h : HasFiniteSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) then ∑ i ∈ h.toFinset, f i.down else 0
results.docstring:
Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise.

results.name: DirichletCharacter.sum_characters_eq_zero
results.source_text:
/-- If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for each `a ≠ 1` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes. -/
theorem sum_characters_eq_zero ⦃a : ZMod n⦄ (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity R ha
  refine eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hχ ?_
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← MulChar.mul_apply]
  exact Fintype.sum_bijective _ (Group.mulLeft_bijective χ) _ _ fun χ' ↦ rfl
results.docstring:
If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for each `a ≠ 1` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes.

results.name: DirichletCharacter.sum_characters_eq
results.source_text:
/-- If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for `a` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes if `a ≠ 1` and has the value `n.totient` if `a = 1`. -/
theorem sum_characters_eq (a : ZMod n) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a = if a = 1 then (n.totient : R) else 0 := by
  split_ifs with ha
  · simpa only [ha, map_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      using congrArg Nat.cast <| card_eq_totient_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity R n
  · exact sum_characters_eq_zero R ha
results.docstring:
If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for `a` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes if `a ≠ 1` and has the value `n.totient` if `a = 1`.

results.name: EuclideanGroup.TranslationGroup
results.source_text:
/-- Translation is the subgroup with Q = 1. -/
def TranslationGroup (n : ℕ) : Subgroup (EuclideanGroup n) where
  carrier := {g | g.linear.val = 1}
  mul_mem' {a b} ha hb := by
    show (a.linear * b.linear).val = 1
    rw [Submonoid.coe_mul, ha, hb, one_mul]
  one_mem' := by
    show (1 : ↥(Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)).val = 1
    rw [OneMemClass.coe_one]
  inv_mem' {a} ha := by
    show (a.linear⁻¹).val = 1
    rw [coe_inv, ha, inv_one]
results.docstring: Translation is the subgroup with Q = 1.

results.name: EuclideanGroup.TranslationGroup.incl
results.source_text:
/-- The inclusion of the translation subgroup into the Euclidean group. -/
noncomputable def TranslationGroup.incl (n : ℕ) :
    TranslationGroup n →* EuclideanGroup n := (TranslationGroup n).subtype
results.docstring: The inclusion of the translation subgroup into the Euclidean group.

results.name: Fintype.prod_sum_type
results.source_text:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem Fintype.prod_sum_type (f : α₁ ⊕ α₂ → M) :
    ∏ x, f x = (∏ a₁, f (Sum.inl a₁)) * ∏ a₂, f (Sum.inr a₂) :=
  prod_disjSum _ _ _

results.name: Fintype.prod_sum
results.source_text:
/-- A product of sums can be written as a sum of products. -/
lemma prod_sum {κ : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (κ i)] (f : ∀ i, κ i → R) :
    ∏ i, ∑ j, f i j = ∑ x : ∀ i, κ i, ∏ i, f i (x i) := Finset.prod_univ_sum _ _
results.docstring: A product of sums can be written as a sum of products.

results.name: Polynomial.sum_def
results.source_text:
theorem sum_def {S : Type*} [AddCommMonoid S] (p : R[X]) (f : ℕ → R → S) :
    p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ p.support, f n (p.coeff n) :=
  rfl

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.

/-- If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for `a` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes if `a ≠ 1` and has the value `n.totient` if `a = 1`. -/
theorem sum_characters_eq (a : ZMod n) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a = if a = 1 then (n.totient : R) else 0 := by
  split_ifs with ha
  · simpa only [ha, map_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      using congrArg Nat.cast <| card_eq_totient_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity R n
  · exact sum_characters_eq_zero R ha
results.docstring:
If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for `a` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes if `a ≠ 1` and has the value `n.totient` if `a = 1`.

results.name: EuclideanGroup.TranslationGroup
results.source_text:
/-- Translation is the subgroup with Q = 1. -/
def TranslationGroup (n : ℕ) : Subgroup (EuclideanGroup n) where
  carrier := {g | g.linear.val = 1}
  mul_mem' {a b} ha hb := by
    show (a.linear * b.linear).val = 1
    rw [Submonoid.coe_mul, ha, hb, one_mul]
  one_mem' := by
    show (1 : ↥(Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)).val = 1
    rw [OneMemClass.coe_one]
  inv_mem' {a} ha := by
    show (a.linear⁻¹).val = 1
    rw [coe_inv, ha, inv_one]
results.docstring: Translation is the subgroup with Q = 1.

results.name: EuclideanGroup.TranslationGroup.incl
results.source_text:
/-- The inclusion of the translation subgroup into the Euclidean group. -/
noncomputable def TranslationGroup.incl (n : ℕ) :
    TranslationGroup n →* EuclideanGroup n := (TranslationGroup n).subtype
results.docstring: The inclusion of the translation subgroup into the Euclidean group.

lemma prod_sum {κ : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (κ i)] (f : ∀ i, κ i → R) :
    ∏ i, ∑ j, f i j = ∑ x : ∀ i, κ i, ∏ i, f i (x i) := Finset.prod_univ_sum _ _

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:

results.name: Order.IsOfFiniteCharacter
results.source_text:
/-- A family of sets $F$ is of finite character iff for every set $X$, $X ∈ F$ iff every finite
subset of $X$ is in $F$ -/
def IsOfFiniteCharacter := ∀ x, x ∈ F ↔ ∀ y ⊆ x, y.Finite → y ∈ F
results.docstring:
A family of sets $F$ is of finite character iff for every set $X$, $X ∈ F$ iff every finite
subset of $X$ is in $F$

results.name: finsum
results.source_text:
/-- Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise. -/
noncomputable irreducible_def finsum (lemma := finsum_def') [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) : M :=
  if h : HasFiniteSupport (f ∘ PLift.down) then ∑ i ∈ h.toFinset, f i.down else 0
results.docstring:
Sum of `f x` as `x` ranges over the elements of the support of `f`, if it's finite. Zero
otherwise.

results.name: DirichletCharacter.sum_characters_eq_zero
results.source_text:
/-- If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for each `a ≠ 1` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes. -/
theorem sum_characters_eq_zero ⦃a : ZMod n⦄ (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity R ha
  refine eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hχ ?_
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← MulChar.mul_apply]
  exact Fintype.sum_bijective _ (Group.mulLeft_bijective χ) _ _ fun χ' ↦ rfl
results.docstring:
If `R` is an integral domain that has enough roots of unity and `n ≠ 0`, then
for each `a ≠ 1` in `ZMod n`, the sum of `χ a` over all Dirichlet characters mod `n`
with values in `R` vanishes.
